sources: https://www.blm.gov/visit/chalk-bluffs-campground (read 2026-11-20): 'Chalk Bluffs has an access road and parking area, vault toilet, eleven overnight camping sites with tent pads, picnic tables, fire rings, RV parking, boat ramp and a parking area large enough for vehicles and drift boat trailers. Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (250 m and two 100 m half-width crops): a gravel loop on the north bank of the North Platte (~70-90 m wide here) with spurs off its south side; three spur pads sit ~5-15 m from the water with only riparian grass between (around 42.6752,-106.6224, 42.6754,-106.6217 and 42.6757,-106.6211); the boat-ramp lot is the SW spur; pin 42.67568691,-106.6236434 is the BLM point at the loop's SW junction, ~150 m from the south row - inside the camp

note: BLM campground and boat ramp on the North Platte River east of Alcova: WY-220 east 7.4 miles, then 3.7 miles on County Road 316. Several spurs on the south side of the loop sit right at the river; a drift-boat launch for the Gray Reef stretch. --Claude
